newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Boehler knocked down by weak Q1.
newsitem.headline: Boehler knocked down by weak Q1.

text.p: Shares in Boehler-Uddeholm, the Austrian high-grade steelmaker, came under pressure on Thursday after it reported substantially weaker turnover and profit figures for the first quarter of 1997.
At 0904 GMT, Boehler was by far the most actively traded stock in Vienna, standing 2.27 percent, or 21 schillings, lower at 906 on turnover of over 47,000 lots.

But one trader said the first quarter results "are made to look worse than they really are" by the one-off effects of record earnings in 1995, when Boehler reported a fourfold increase in net profit due to cost-cutting.

For the first quarter, Boehler said net profit before minority interests hit 117 million schillings after 315 million in the first three months of 1996, but pointed out that the order intake climbed four percent. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
